name: Microsoft Loop
description: Microsoft Loop is Microsoft's collaborative workspace for organizing projects with shared workspaces, flexible pages, and portable live components. Teams use it to co-create notes, tables, task lists, links, and other project content that stays synchronized across Loop and Microsoft 365 apps.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft Loop cannot currently be connected directly to Relay agents because Microsoft publishes no supported production Loop account API or Microsoft Graph resource for Loop workspaces, pages, components, and structured content.

blocked.label: Connect a Microsoft Loop account
blocked.description: Microsoft does not publish a supported production Loop OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract that Relay can register and distribute.

blocked.label: Use Loop workspaces, pages, or components
blocked.description: Microsoft Graph does not document a production Loop resource for reading or changing Loop workspaces, pages, components, or their structured content.

blocked.label: Use file metadata or private endpoints as a workaround
blocked.description: Generic driveItem metadata does not provide a supported structured Loop content API, and Relay will not depend on beta, private, reverse-engineered, or browser-automation surfaces.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported production Microsoft Loop account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported production Microsoft Loop account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported production Microsoft Loop account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft documents Loop as a collaborative Microsoft 365 product but does not publish a supported production API for Loop workspaces, pages, components, or structured content. Microsoft Graph exposes generic file resources, not a supported Loop content contract, and Microsoft support answers continue to state that no public Loop API is available.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect, request Microsoft credentials, map Loop files onto generic driveItem metadata, or use private and beta endpoints. Reconsider only if Microsoft publishes a supported production Loop content API or remote MCP service with an independently distributable third-party authorization contract.

evidence.supports: Microsoft describes Loop workspaces, pages, and portable components that stay synchronized across Loop and Microsoft 365 apps.
Microsoft's supported Graph overview and resource navigation do not publish a Microsoft Loop workspace, page, component, or structured-content resource.
A Microsoft Learn support answer states that Microsoft Loop has no public API and gives no official timeline for one.
A current Microsoft Learn request for programmatic Loop workspace and page access is directed to Microsoft's feedback channel rather than to a supported API.
